M O N T S E R R A T
No. 21 of 2013
AN ACT TO AMEND THE FINANCIAL SERVICES COMMISSION ACT,
(NO. 3 OF 2008).
BE IT ENACTED by the Queen’s Most Excellent Majesty, by and
with the advice and consent of the Legislative Assembly of
Montserrat and by the Authority of the same as follows:
1 Short title and commencement
(1) This Act may be cited as the Financial Services
Commission (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) This Act comes into force on a date appointed by the
Governor, by Order published in the Gazette.
2 Section 4 amended
Section 4(1) of the Financial Services Commission Act,
(No. 3 of 2008) is amended by inserting after paragraph
(j) the following paragraph:
______________________________________________________
2

Montserrat
Financial Services Commission (Amendment) Act 2013
No. 21 of 2013
“(ja) to facilitate the registration of companies, patents
United Kingdom patents, trademarks, business
names, businesses and associated administrative
functions undertaken by a person designated as
Registrar under any enactment including the
following:
(i) Companies Act, (Cap. 11.12);
(ii) Trade Marks Act, (Cap. 15.23);
(iii) Patents Act, (Cap. 15.11);
(iv) Registration of United Kingdom Patents Act,
(Cap. 15.22);
(v) Micro and Small Business Act, (No. 2 of
2013);
(vi) Friendly Societies Act, (Cap. 11.19);
(vii) Registration of Business Names Act, (Cap.
11.11).”.
Teresina Bodkin (Sgd.)
SPEAKER
Passed by the Legislative Assembly this 17th day of December,
2013.
Judith Baker (Sgd.)
CLERK OF LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY
